import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0066.png')
# obs_0066 was at x=0.8645, y=4.2658, heading=90.0 (facing +x towards sofa)
# Let's see if sofa front/seat is visible in obs_0066
# In obs_0066, heading is 90 (facing East).
# The sofa is to the East!
print('obs_0066 non-wall non-floor pixels:')
diff = img[:, :, 0].astype(int) - img[:, :, 2].astype(int)
sofa = (diff > 5) & (img[:, :, 0] > 80) & (img[:, :, 0] < 170)
ys, xs = np.where(sofa)
if len(xs) > 0:
    print(f'obs_0066 sofa cols: [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], rows: [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}]')
else:
    print('No sofa in obs_0066')
"
